summary: False implication due to communal rivalry; delayed witness statements (2-3 days post-incident); inconsistent testimonies regarding riots; eyewitness credibility challenged (PW1-2 hostile, PW3-6 contradictions on knife disposal, crowd size); motive unestablished; no prior criminal record; benefit of doubt warranted; conviction under s.302 IPC unsustainable.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction and sentence set aside; appellant acquitted.
